title: Ladakh – Khardung La and Nubra Valley
subject: Geography
caption: Map of Ladakh highlighting Khardung La pass, Nubra Valley, and major Buddhist monasteries.
altText: A textbook-quality map of India with the Union Territory of Ladakh highlighted; Khardung La pass is shown as a red triangle labeled, Nubra Valley is shaded light blue and labeled, and several Buddhist monasteries are marked with golden dome icons and their names.
